nodes.label: benchmarks workflow
nodes.rationale: A smoke-level gate that proves the suite still compiles and still runs against the current src/ API — it measures nothing, because benchmark numbers from a shared CI runner are noise. It triggers on src/** too, since the failure mode is a source change orphaning a benchmark, which is invisible from the benchmark side of the diff.

nodes.label: benchmarks job (typecheck + smoke)
nodes.rationale: typecheck:bench is the stricter check for this failure class — a missing barrel export is a TS2305 even when the binding is never called, whereas Bun elides an unused named import at runtime. bench:smoke then catches wiring that is type-correct but wrong at runtime. `worker` is excluded on hosted runners for the same cause as the multi-node quarantine, and shares its exit criterion.

nodes.label: comparison arms job
nodes.rationale: The comparison tree carries its own package.json and lockfile, so it is invisible to every other job and would be checked by nothing at all — which is exactly how ten benchmark suites sat broken on a removed export for months (#506). Two installs, two manifests; smoke mode writes no result files, since a single unwarmed iteration measures the JIT and letting it reach results/ would replace a committed median with noise.
